_about: The office's settings, written by tools/make-office.py between the office:settings markers in netlify/cb/lib.mjs, the only copy the server reads. The pipelines and their stages are EspoCRM's, word for word and in its order (read 2026-10-20): each stage says which status it puts a grant request in, and the first stage of each is where a new one starts. Statuses are EspoCRM's three. Amounts are whole dollars, as EspoCRM held every one. Cases are EspoCRM's too: its two types, its seven statuses in its order, each saying whether a case is still open, and its four priorities. The intake says what each of stimpunks.org's forms makes when the WPForms plugin posts an entry: its name's prefix, and a grant request's pipeline and amount or a case's type, as the plugin made them in EspoCRM.
_dashboard: dashboard: the operations dashboard's settings. active_cap is EspoCRM's 'Active Grant Applications (100 cap)': how many open grant requests submitted this calendar year each pipeline is capped at (Ryan, 2026-10-21: 100 per pipeline). Changing it is a line here and a run of tools/check-all.sh.
